# Statements {.unnumbered}

**Use of AI tools.** This study was carried out with Claude, a language model made by Anthropic, running in Claude Code. Under the author's direction, Claude wrote the code, ran the analyses, drafted the pre-analysis plan (with a recommended option for each decision in its register, all of which the author accepted at signing, @sec-app-pap) and this paper, and ran the red-team review; separate model instances implemented and reviewed each task. The author set the research questions and hypotheses, signed the pre-analysis plan, approved every deviation from it (@sec-app-deviations) and takes responsibility for the content. No number in the paper is typed: each is generated by the code of the replication package (@sec-app-replication). The AEI data are conversations with Claude matched to O\*NET tasks, so the assistant is a product of the firm whose data and product are studied. Anthropic did not fund, review or approve this study, and the confirmatory tests were fixed by the tagged protocol and its guards before their outcomes were read (@sec-methods), not by the assistant's judgement afterwards.

**Declaration of interests.** The author has no employment, funding, consulting or equity relationship with Anthropic, OpenAI or any other AI developer, and holds no position in the industry portfolios studied beyond broad index funds.

**Licences and data.** The code is released under the {{< var meta.licence.code >}} and the text, results and figures under {{< var meta.licence.text >}}. The raw data keep their sources' terms, which the replication package's README quotes with each source's attribution; the frozen raw archive is deposited as that README describes, with the files whose sources state no licence available on request (@sec-app-replication). This paper includes information from the O\*NET Database by the U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration (USDOL/ETA), used under the {{< var meta.licence.text >}} licence; the author has modified all or some of this information, and USDOL/ETA has not approved, endorsed or tested these modifications.
